tasks.label: Apply shared project header
args: const fs=require('fs'); for (const file of fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.html'))) { let s=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'); if(!s.includes('assets/project-header.css')) s=s.replace('</head>','<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/project-header.css">\n</head>'); if(!s.includes('assets/project-header.js')) s=s.replace('</body>','<script src="assets/project-header.js"></script>\n</body>'); fs.writeFileSync(file,s,'utf8'); } console.log('Shared header assets linked to all HTML pages');

tasks.label: Generate Numbers commentary pilot
args: Work only in this repository. Produce the next approved Arabic Bible commentary batch for Numbers 1:17-31. Read build-numbers-four-line-01a.js as the exact style/schema model, bible.json for verse text, sources/commentaries/numbers/draft-chapter-01.json for traceable source arrays and interpreter_names, and commentary-quality-policy.json. Create only build-numbers-four-line-01b.js and sources/commentaries/numbers/approved-chapter-01b.json. Each verse must have exactly four original Arabic lines: academic, theological, deep, applied; each line 55-230 chars, total <=760 chars; no unsupported language/history claims; no repeated 8-word phrase; preserve exact sources and interpreter_names. Do not alter any existing file. Run node validate-commentary-quality.js on the generated JSON and repair until it passes. Return concise result.

tasks.label: Build commentary production orchestrator
args: Work only in this repository. Implement a robust resumable production orchestrator for the remaining approved four-line Arabic Bible commentary. Read bible.json, commentary-worklist.json, commentary-quality-policy.json, validate-commentary-quality.js, validate-approved-commentary-cumulative.js, sync-approved-commentary-worklist.js, sources/commentaries/whole-bible/mhc-source-index.json, commentary-support-index.json, sources/commentaries/numbers/source-index.json, and existing build-numbers-four-line/approved files. Requirements: one user command; internally chunk at most 16 verses; invoke the installed authenticated Copilot CLI non-interactively using its npm-loader.js via Node spawnSync, max 30 credits per chunk; generate source packet per chunk with exact verse text, deduplicated primary source records/text/locators, and precise supplemental links; for Numbers prefer its three-source index, otherwise use whole-Bible primary index; request exactly four Arabic lines academic/theological/deep/applied within policy and exact interpreter names; write outputs under sources/commentaries/approved/<book>/; run validate-commentary-quality.js after every chunk; enforce global repeated eight-word phrase prevention incrementally; retry a failed chunk at most twice with validator feedback; never mark failed content approved; persist progress/report JSON after every chunk; resume by skipping already approved verse keys; stop cleanly on auth/quota/error; provide --dry-run and --max-chunks options; aggregate approved records into per-book commentary-data/<book>.json matching bible.html academic_synthesis explanation_lines schema; do not alter bible.json, existing approved commentary, or bible.html. Add concise README instructions and VS Code tasks for dry run and full run. Add tests using a mock CLI so orchestration logic can be validated without credits. Run tests. Return concise result.

tasks.label: Extract original Bible texts
args: if exist sources\original-languages\hboWLC rmdir /s /q sources\original-languages\hboWLC & if exist sources\original-languages\grcbyz rmdir /s /q sources\original-languages\grcbyz & mkdir sources\original-languages\hboWLC & mkdir sources\original-languages\grcbyz & tar -xf sources\original-languages\hboWLC_usfm.zip -C sources\original-languages\hboWLC & tar -xf sources\original-languages\grcbyz_usfm.zip -C sources\original-languages\grcbyz & dir /s /b sources\original-languages\*.usfm

tasks.label: Download original Bible texts cleanly
args: if not exist sources\original-languages mkdir sources\original-languages & curl.exe -L --fail https://ebible.org/Scriptures/hboWLC_usfm.zip -o sources\original-languages\hboWLC_usfm.zip & curl.exe -L --fail https://ebible.org/Scriptures/grcbyz_usfm.zip -o sources\original-languages\grcbyz_usfm.zip & mkdir sources\original-languages\hboWLC 2>nul & mkdir sources\original-languages\grcbyz 2>nul & tar -xf sources\original-languages\hboWLC_usfm.zip -C sources\original-languages\hboWLC & tar -xf sources\original-languages\grcbyz_usfm.zip -C sources\original-languages\grcbyz & dir /s /b sources\original-languages

tasks.label: Download Textus Receptus fallback
args: curl.exe -L --fail https://ebible.org/Scriptures/grctr_usfm.zip -o sources\original-languages\grctr_usfm.zip & mkdir sources\original-languages\grctr 2>nul & tar -xf sources\original-languages\grctr_usfm.zip -C sources\original-languages\grctr

args: wmic process where "name='node.exe' and commandline like '%run-approved-commentary-orchestrator.js%'" get ProcessId,CommandLine /format:list
